description: Retrieve the details of a specific organization merge operation in Zendesk. This action shows the merge status and the organizations involved. Use when you need to check the status of an organization merge or view details of a past merge operation. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving an organization merge.

organization_merge_id.description: The ID of the organization merge to retrieve. Must be a non-null string value. This is typically a numeric string ID obtained from a previous organization merge operation.
organization_merge_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier for the organization merge. You can find this ID from the response when creating or listing organization merges.
organization_merge_id.title: Organization Merge Id
